title: SDG Hackathon 2026
description: An innovation challenge organized by SRMIST where participants create technology-driven solutions for real-world problems aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals.
organizer: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur Campus
venue: TP Ganesan Mini Hall 2, SRMIST Kattankulathur Campus

title: Thinkathon 2026 - 10 Hour Design Thinking Workshop & Hackathon
description: A ten-hour design-thinking workshop and hackathon covering user needs, problem definition, human-centred ideation, and the presentation of solutions to real-world challenges.

title: Startupthon 2026 - 10 Hour Startup Workshop & Hackathon
description: A ten-hour startup workshop and hackathon organized by Top Engineers for participants interested in building and developing startup ideas through an intensive, practical event.

title: IdeaCraft 2026 - Crafting Innovation Across Silicon & Code
description: An inter-college, on-the-spot technical pitching sprint where engineering students develop and present ideas across AI, IoT, VLSI, embedded systems, and sustainable technology. Teams consist of exactly two students.
venue: 4th Floor, Green Building, Rajalakshmi Institute of Technology

title: Robo Sumo 2026
description: A competitive robotics event where participants use robot design, control, and strategy to push an opponent's robot out of the arena.
venue: SRM Easwari Engineering College, Bharathi Salai, Ramapuram

title: SustainAgentic Bootcamp 2026
description: A hands-on bootcamp about designing sustainable intelligent agentic AI systems and building responsible applications for real-world environmental challenges.
organizer: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur Campus
venue: SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur Campus
